zh.title: 國防部偵獲12架次共機及7艘共艦 10架次逾越台海中線
zh.summary: 台灣國防部公布，自7月29日至30日上午6時止，共偵獲中國軍機12架次、軍艦7艘次及公務船1艘，其中有10架次共機逾越台海中線進入西南與東部空域。國軍已運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統進行監控。根據本站統計，今日偵獲軍機架次較前一日的6架次有所增加。
body: 台灣國防部於2026年7月30日發布共機與共艦之最新動態。根據統計，自7月29日上午6時起至30日上午6時止，國軍共偵獲中國軍機12架次、軍艦7艘次以及公務船1艘，持續在台海周邊活動。其中有10架次共機逾越台海中線，侵擾台灣西南及東部空域。
面對共機與共艦的侵擾活動，國防部強調，國軍已運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統，對周邊動態進行嚴密監控與因應。此外，根據本站統計紀錄，前一日（7月29日）所偵獲的中國軍機為6架次、軍艦7艘次及公務船1艘，顯示今日偵獲的軍機架次有所增加。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 12 Chinese Aircraft and 7 Warships Near Strait
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 12 Chinese military aircraft, 7 warships, and 1 official ship near the island between July 29 and July 30, 2026. Among these, 10 aircraft crossed the Taiwan Strait median line into the southwestern and eastern airspace. Taiwan's military utilized aircraft, vessels, and missile systems to monitor the situation. According to AVWIRE database statistics, this marks an increase in military aircraft compared to the 6 aircraft recorded on the previous day, July 29.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released the latest movements of Chinese military aircraft and vessels on July 30, 2026. According to the official statistics, between 6:00 AM on July 29 and 6:00 AM on July 30, a total of 12 Chinese military aircraft, 7 warships, and 1 official ship were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait. Among them, 10 military aircraft crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering Taiwan's southwestern and eastern airspace.

In response to these activities, the Ministry of National Defense emphasized that Taiwan's military utilized mission aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the situation. Additionally, according to AVWIRE database statistics, the previous record on July 29 showed 6 Chinese military aircraft, 7 warships, and 1 official ship, indicating an increase in the number of detected aircraft today.
